common.offlineBanner: Offline: your PC is not reachable. Deliveries are kept on the phone and sync when it is back.

permission.cameraNeeded: Camera access is needed to photograph the scanner list.

stops.title: Stops
stops.emptyBody: Photograph your scanner's stop list. Several photos are fine; overlaps are merged.
stops.removeConfirmBody: {{address}} will be taken off the tour.
stops.openHint: Opens the stop to edit it

scan.emptyBody: Point the camera at a DPD label to see its loading number while you load, or to check it's the right parcel at the door.
scan.autoAddLabel: Add new labels to the tour automatically
scan.replanHint: re-plan to give it a loading number
scan.needsSquareCode: Scan the square code on the label to add it: the long barcode has no street.
scan.whichStop: Which stop is this parcel for?

capture.title: Capture the scanner list
capture.onPhone: Read on this phone. Photos never leave it.
capture.onPc: Photos are read on your PC.
capture.inAppHint: Photograph the scanner list. Several pages are fine.
capture.autoLabel: Take photos by itself while I scroll
capture.liveFound_one: Scroll the scanner list slowly · {{count}} stop found
capture.liveFound_other: Scroll the scanner list slowly · {{count}} stops found
capture.readingPhotos: Reading photos… keep the app open

coverage.unknown: Enter the stop count your scanner shows to check nothing is missing.
coverage.complete: Every stop on the scanner is captured.
coverage.missing: {{n}} missing. Photograph the rest of the list.
coverage.extra: {{n}} more than the scanner shows. Check for duplicates.
coverage.progressLabel: Stops captured vs. the scanner count

route.moveHint: Hold a stop to drag it, or tap it to move it to a position.
route.ownOrder: Your order: kept when you plan again.
route.emptyBody: Capture your stops, then plan. The fastest order, grouped into park-and-walk stops, appears here.
route.lateNote: {{stops}} can't be reached in time: {{list}}{{more}}. Planned as early as the route allows.
route.deliverOnFoot: Deliver on foot from a nearby stop.
route.plannedPhoneRoad: Planned on this phone with road times.
route.plannedPhoneEstimate: Planned on this phone: times are estimated from distance{{note}}.
route.roadworksPcOnly: Roadworks and closures are only known to your PC.
route.emptyBodyScanned: Capture your stops, then start. They appear here in your scanner's order, nothing re-ordered.
route.lateNoteScanned: {{stops}} will be late in the scanner's order: {{list}}{{more}}.
route.inScannerOrder: In your scanner's order, nothing re-ordered.
route.notStartedYet: Not started yet: times count from now until your first Navigate or Delivered.
route.notPlannedEditHint: Opens the stop to fix its address
route.notPlannedHint: Tap one to fix its address, then re-plan. Navigation still finds it by its address, and you can tick it off here.

settings.startEndFooter: Without a depot, routes start from your current location.
settings.returnToDepotHint: Plan the drive back as part of the route
settings.leaveAtHint: ETAs and Express count from here. Empty: from your first Navigate or Delivered
settings.expressFooter: On time: Express stops are reached by their deadline, minus the buffer; everything else stays fastest (usually costs a few minutes). Off: the fastest tour, Express only shown. Express first: all Express stops before the rest, whatever their deadline.
settings.navFooter: Navigation opens in this app, which shows on your {{screen}} screen. Deliver on the phone, drive by the car's display.
settings.autoNavigateHint: After Delivered, start navigation to the next stop
settings.roadClosuresNoPcFooter: Roadworks, the city's traffic calendar and closures you report live on your PC. In phone-only mode plans don't know about them.
settings.availableWithPc: Available when you use your PC.
settings.closuresFooter: City of Cologne: {{roadworks}} roadworks and {{calendar}} traffic-calendar closures active today{{updated}}. The map itself, one-way streets included, refreshes every night.
settings.noClosures: None reported. Use the cone button on the Route tab when a street is closed or has become one-way.
settings.planningAutoFooter: Plans on your PC when it answers (road map with roadworks and closures), on this phone when it doesn't. Text recognition: {{where}}.
settings.planningPhoneFooter: Everything runs on this phone: reading lists and labels, addresses, and the stop order. No PC needed.
settings.usePcHint: Best plans when it's reachable over Tailscale
settings.readPhotosOnPcHint: Its vision model instead of this phone's text recognition
settings.orsKeySavedFooter: Key saved (ends in …{{last4}}). It is the second source of road times, and the phone starts its own search for the best order from its route optimizer's (VROOM, up to 48 parking stops).
settings.orsKeyMissingFooter: Optional. Plans made on this phone already use OpenStreetMap's public router (one-way streets, kerb side). A free openrouteservice.org key adds a second source of road times and a head start for the order from its route optimizer. Needs internet, not the PC.
settings.geoapifyFooter: Optional. A free geoapify.com key (3,000 lookups a day) is the third address finder, asked only for a stop the phone and OpenStreetMap could not place.
settings.clearTourBody: All {{n}} stops, the route and delivery ticks are removed from this phone and the web app.
settings.clearCacheBody: Deletes the scanner photos kept on this phone and every address it remembers. Your tour and its history stay. The next plan looks each address up again, so it takes a little longer.
settings.routeStyleFooter: Park & walk: stops within 80 m share one parking spot and you walk between them. Door to door: you drive up to nearly every stop; only next-door neighbours share a spot. Takes effect at the next plan.
settings.updateChecking: Checking GitHub for a newer release…
settings.updateFailed: Couldn't reach GitHub. Try again with internet.
settings.updateHintAndroid: A newer release is out. Download the APK and open it to install over this app.
settings.updateHintIos: A newer release is out. Download the .ipa from the release page on your PC and sideload it with Sideloadly.
settings.orderFastestFooter: The app plans the quickest order, grouped into parking stops. Takes effect at the next plan.
settings.orderScannedFooter: The stops stay in the order of your scanner photos and screenshots; nothing is re-ordered. Only next-door neighbours on the list share a parking spot. Navigate, Delivered and arrival times work as usual. Takes effect at the next plan.
settings.bothSidesOnHint: Stop on your side and cross on foot: each street is driven once
settings.bothSidesOffHint: Always stop on the door's side: a street with stops on both sides is driven twice
settings.expressMarginHint: A buffer before each Express deadline for traffic, parking and finding the door
settings.expressFirstHint: Deliver every Express stop before the rest
settings.alertsFooter: On this phone only, no internet needed. Arrival details need location access set to "Always".
settings.expressAlertsHint: A notification 30 and 10 min before each open Express deadline, read out while the app is open
settings.arrivalAlertsHint: Arriving at a stop shows its names, PRIO and time slot, so you don't need the scanner
settings.expressScannedFooter: With the stop order "As scanned" nothing is re-ordered: Express stops that will be late are flagged on the Route tab.
settings.keepHistoryHint: Keeps each day's stops, the order you delivered them in and where you were at each Delivered, on this phone only, to plan better later
settings.detailedLogHint: Also record why: each address lookup, what was read from each photo, how the order came about
settings.exportUnavailable: Sharing files is not available on this device.
settings.logFooter: Something went wrong? Turn on the detailed log, scan or plan again, then export and send the file. It holds the addresses and names from your scanner list and the tour history, but no keys and no server address.

closure.reportLabel: Report a closed road or a new one-way street here
closure.title: Road blocked here?
closure.closedDesc: Closed: the street at your location is avoided for 14 days.
closure.onewayDesc: New one-way: point the phone the way you may not drive; only that direction is blocked, for 180 days.
closure.replanDesc: The rest of your tour is re-planned around it.

store.cantReachPc: Can't reach your PC. Is Tailscale on? Your changes stay on the phone and sync when it's back.
store.readingStops: Reading stops… keep the app open

planning.places: Finding the addresses on the map…

delivery.notNextStop: It is not your next stop.

plan.noStopsPlaced: No stops could be placed on the map

location.permissionNeeded: Location permission is needed to plan from where you are. Or set a depot in Settings.
location.noFix: Couldn't get your location. Step outside for a GPS fix, or set a depot in Settings.

map.dragHint: Hold and drag to fix the position
map.webPlaceholder: The map shows in the phone app

history.title: Past deliveries
history.empty: Each day's tour is kept here once it is planned.
history.off: Tour history is off (Settings → Log), so nothing new is kept.
history.kept: Kept on this phone for a year. Clear cache doesn't touch it; deleting the app does, so Export log keeps a copy.
history.vsPlanLater: Last stop {{n}} min later than planned
history.vsPlanEarlier: Last stop {{n}} min earlier than planned
history.gapHint: Times run from one Delivered tap to the next, so getting to a stop counts towards it. With arrival details on, each stop also shows how much of that was getting there and how much at the stop.
history.split: Getting there ⌀ {{drive}} min · at the stop ⌀ {{at}} min
